caseName: Knights of the Ku Klux Klan v. Kansas ex rel. Griffith
caseNameFull: Knights of the Ku Klux Klan v. State of Kansas ex rel. Charles B. Griffith, Attorney General
attorneys: Mr. John S. Dean, with whom Messrs. William F. Zumbrunn, Harris W. Colmery, Benjamin H. Sullivan, John H. Connaughton, and William B. Brown were on the brief,, for plaintiff in error., Messrs. Charles B. Griffith, John G. Egan, and Thomas A. Lee were on the brief, for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of a federal question on the authority of Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569; Hull v. Burr, 234 U. S. 712, 720; and Norton v. Whiteside, 239 U. S. 144, 147.
